sloka: दूतो ऽस्म्यतिबलस्याहं महर्षेरमितौजसः ।रामं दिदृक्षुरायातः कार्येण हि महाबल ।। ७.१०३.३ ॥
transliteration: dūto 'smyatibalasyāhaṁ maharṣeramitaujasaḥ ।rāmaṁ didṛkṣurāyātaḥ kāryeṇa hi mahābala ।। 7.103.3 ॥

translations.english: "O mighty one, I am indeed a messenger of a very powerful great sage of immeasurable energy, and I have arrived desirous of seeing Rama for an important purpose."
